data.title: About this report
data.content: Findings, counts and line numbers come from barrierlab 's --json output for its own examples/page.html (one run, unedited). barrierlab does not write PDFs; this request was assembled from that output. The recommendations are written by hand.

data.title: forms/label-missing: The input has no label.
data.recommendation: Give the input a visible label tied to it with for/id, or wrap the input in a label element.

data.title: links/name-missing: The link has no accessible name.
data.recommendation: Put text in the link, or an aria-label if it only holds an icon.

data.title: buttons/name-missing: The button has no accessible name.
data.recommendation: Put text in the button, or an aria-label if it only holds an icon.

data.title: images/alt-missing: The image has no alt attribute.
data.recommendation: Add an alt attribute: a short text that says what the image means here, or alt="" if it is purely decorative.

data.title: contrast/text-insufficient: The text reaches a contrast ratio of 2.59:1; 4.5:1 is required for normal text.
data.recommendation: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio reaches 4.5:1.
